t: 建立美国公务员制度的"彭德尔顿公务员改革法"由国会颁布.
te: The Pendleton Civil Service Reform Act, establishing the United States Civil Service, is enacted by Congress.
dz: 建立美国公务员制度的"彭德尔顿公务员改革法"由国会颁布.
de: The Pendleton Civil Service Reform Act, establishing the United States Civil Service, is enacted by Congress.

t: 第一个采用架空电线的电气照明系统由托马斯·爱迪生建造，在新泽西州罗塞尔开始使用。
te: The first electric lighting system employing overhead wires, built by Thomas Edison, begins service at Roselle, New Jer…
dz: 第一个采用架空电线的电气照明系统由托马斯·爱迪生建造，在新泽西州罗塞尔开始使用。
de: The first electric lighting system employing overhead wires, built by Thomas Edison, begins service at Roselle, New Jersey.

t: 阿拉巴马州成为美国第一个颁布反垄断法的州。
te: Alabama becomes the first U.S. state to enact an anti-trust law.
dz: 阿拉巴马州成为美国第一个颁布反垄断法的州。
de: Alabama becomes the first U.S. state to enact an anti-trust law.

t: 巴黎无政府主义者,失业和木匠在暴力抗议中狭隘地怀念总统府;路易丝·米歇尔先用黑旗来象征无政府主…
te: Parisian anarchists, unemployed and carpenters narrowly miss the Presidential palace during a violent protest; first us…
dz: 1883年3月9日的示威游行:巴黎无政府主义者,失业和木匠在暴力抗议中狭隘地怀念总统府;路易丝·米歇尔先用黑旗来象征无政府主义.
de: Demonstration of 9 March 1883:  Parisian anarchists, unemployed and carpenters narrowly miss the Presidential palace during a violent protest; first use of the black flag as a symbol of anarchism by Louise Michel.

t: 签署《保护工业产权巴黎公约》。
te: The Paris Convention for the Protection of Industrial Property is signed.
dz: 签署《保护工业产权巴黎公约》。
de: The Paris Convention for the Protection of Industrial Property is signed.

t: 水牛比尔首个"水牛比尔狂野西部"在内布拉斯加州奥马哈开通.
te: Buffalo Bill's first Buffalo Bill's Wild West opens in Omaha, Nebraska.
dz: 水牛比尔首个"水牛比尔狂野西部"在内布拉斯加州奥马哈开通.
de: Buffalo Bill's first Buffalo Bill's Wild West opens in Omaha, Nebraska.

t: 喀拉喀托火山开始爆发;火山于三个月后爆发,造成36000多人死亡.
te: Krakatoa begins to erupt; the volcano explodes three months later, killing more than 36,000 people.
dz: 喀拉喀托火山开始爆发;火山于三个月后爆发,造成36000多人死亡.
de: Krakatoa begins to erupt; the volcano explodes three months later, killing more than 36,000 people.

t: 纽约市布鲁克林大桥经过14年的建设后开放给交通.
te: The Brooklyn Bridge in New York City is opened to traffic after 14 years of construction.
dz: 纽约市布鲁克林大桥经过14年的建设后开放给交通.
de: The Brooklyn Bridge in New York City is opened to traffic after 14 years of construction.

t: 亚历山大三世被加冕为俄罗斯沙皇.
te: Alexander III is crowned Tsar of Russia.
dz: 亚历山大三世被加冕为俄罗斯沙皇.
de: Alexander III is crowned Tsar of Russia.

t: 在纽约市,12人死于最近开放的布鲁克林大桥上的一通邮票.
te: In New York City, 12 people are killed in a stampede on the recently opened Brooklyn Bridge.
dz: 在纽约市,12人死于最近开放的布鲁克林大桥上的一通邮票.
de: In New York City, 12 people are killed in a stampede on the recently opened Brooklyn Bridge.

t: 第一辆定期预定的东方快车驶出巴黎
te: The first regularly scheduled Orient Express departs Paris.[citation needed]
dz: 第一辆定期预定的东方快车驶出巴黎
de: The first regularly scheduled Orient Express departs Paris.[citation needed]

t: 英国桑德兰的维多利亚会堂剧院恐慌,造成183名儿童死亡.
te: The Victoria Hall theatre panic in Sunderland, England, kills 183 children.
dz: 英国桑德兰的维多利亚会堂剧院恐慌,造成183名儿童死亡.
de: The Victoria Hall theatre panic in Sunderland, England, kills 183 children.

t: 由亚历杭德罗·戈罗斯蒂亚加率领的智利人于花马楚克战役中击败了安德烈斯·阿韦利诺·卡塞雷斯的秘鲁…
te: Chileans led by Alejandro Gorostiaga defeat Andrés Avelino Cáceres's Peruvian army at the Battle of Huamachuco, hasteni…
dz: 太平洋之战:由亚历杭德罗·戈罗斯蒂亚加率领的智利人于花马楚克战役中击败了安德烈斯·阿韦利诺·卡塞雷斯的秘鲁军队,使战争迅速结束.
de: War of the Pacific: Chileans led by Alejandro Gorostiaga defeat Andrés Avelino Cáceres's Peruvian army at the Battle of Huamachuco, hastening the end of the war.

t: 意大利伊希亚岛发生规模为4.3-5.2的中度地震,造成2300多人死亡.
te: A moderate earthquake measuring magnitude 4.3–5.2 strikes the Italian island of Ischia, killing over 2,300 people.
dz: 意大利伊希亚岛发生规模为4.3-5.2的中度地震,造成2300多人死亡.
de: A moderate earthquake measuring magnitude 4.3–5.2 strikes the Italian island of Ischia, killing over 2,300 people.

t: 最后的石窟死在荷兰阿姆斯特丹的动物园Natura Artis Magistra.
te: The last quagga dies at the Natura Artis Magistra, a zoo in Amsterdam, Netherlands.
dz: 最后的石窟死在荷兰阿姆斯特丹的动物园Natura Artis Magistra.
de: The last quagga dies at the Natura Artis Magistra, a zoo in Amsterdam, Netherlands.

t: 多米尼加共和国国歌"Himno Nacional"首次公开出道.
te: The first public performance of the Dominican Republic's national anthem, Himno Nacional.
dz: 多米尼加共和国国歌"Himno Nacional"首次公开出道.
de: The first public performance of the Dominican Republic's national anthem, Himno Nacional.

t: 一场F5龙卷风袭击了明尼苏达州的罗切斯特,导致马约诊所的创建.
te: An F5 tornado strikes Rochester, Minnesota, leading to the creation of the Mayo Clinic.
dz: 一场F5龙卷风袭击了明尼苏达州的罗切斯特,导致马约诊所的创建.
de: An F5 tornado strikes Rochester, Minnesota, leading to the creation of the Mayo Clinic.

t: 法国和越南签署了"胡瓦克条约",承认了法国对安娜姆和通金的保护地.
te: France and Viet Nam sign the Treaty of Huế, recognizing a French protectorate over Annam and Tonkin.
dz: 法国和越南签署了"胡瓦克条约",承认了法国对安娜姆和通金的保护地.
de: France and Viet Nam sign the Treaty of Huế, recognizing a French protectorate over Annam and Tonkin.

t: 1883年喀拉喀托火山爆发开始其最终的,麻痹,舞台.
te: The 1883 eruption of Krakatoa begins its final, paroxysmal, stage.
dz: 1883年喀拉喀托火山爆发开始其最终的,麻痹,舞台.
de: The 1883 eruption of Krakatoa begins its final, paroxysmal, stage.

t: 有四起巨大的爆炸几乎完全摧毁了喀拉喀托亚岛,海啸和烟火性流合而为一,造成超过36000人死亡.…
te: Four enormous explosions almost completely destroy the island of Krakatoa, with a combination of tsunamis and pyroclast…
dz: 喀拉喀托亚的喷发:有四起巨大的爆炸几乎完全摧毁了喀拉喀托亚岛,海啸和烟火性流合而为一,造成超过36000人死亡. 全世界都观察到气候影响.
de: Eruption of Krakatoa: Four enormous explosions almost completely destroy the island of Krakatoa, with a combination of tsunamis and pyroclastic flows killing more than 36,000.  Climate effects are observed worldwide.

t: 北太平洋铁路（报告标记 NP）在蒙大拿州 Gold Creek 举行的仪式上竣工。前总统尤利西…
te: The Northern Pacific Railway (reporting mark NP) was completed in a ceremony at Gold Creek, Montana. Former president U…
dz: 北太平洋铁路（报告标记 NP）在蒙大拿州 Gold Creek 举行的仪式上竣工。前总统尤利西斯·S·格兰特 (Ulysses S. Grant) 在铁路和政治名人出席的活动中驾驶着最后一颗“金钉”。
de: The Northern Pacific Railway (reporting mark NP) was completed in a ceremony at Gold Creek, Montana. Former president Ulysses S. Grant drove in the final "golden spike" in an event attended by rail and political luminaries.

t: 苏格兰格拉斯哥的男孩队第一次会议.
te: First meeting of the Boys' Brigade in Glasgow, Scotland.
dz: 苏格兰格拉斯哥的男孩队第一次会议.
de: First meeting of the Boys' Brigade in Glasgow, Scotland.

t: 秘鲁和智利签署《安孔条约》，将塔拉帕卡省割让给智利，结束了秘鲁对太平洋战争的卷入。
te: Peru and Chile sign the Treaty of Ancón, by which the Tarapacá province is ceded to the latter, bringing an end to Peru…
dz: 秘鲁和智利签署《安孔条约》，将塔拉帕卡省割让给智利，结束了秘鲁对太平洋战争的卷入。
de: Peru and Chile sign the Treaty of Ancón, by which the Tarapacá province is ceded to the latter, bringing an end to Peru's involvement in the War of the Pacific.

t: 纽约市的大都会歌剧院以查尔斯·古诺德所出演的"浮士德"为开场作曲.
te: The Metropolitan Opera House in New York City opens with a performance of Charles Gounod's Faust.
dz: 纽约市的大都会歌剧院以查尔斯·古诺德所出演的"浮士德"为开场作曲.
de: The Metropolitan Opera House in New York City opens with a performance of Charles Gounod's Faust.

t: 在"正午两日"中,美国和加拿大铁路公司建立了四个标准的大陆时区,结束了当地上千个时代的混乱.
te: In the "day of two noons", American and Canadian railroad companies institute four standard continental time zones, end…
dz: 在"正午两日"中,美国和加拿大铁路公司建立了四个标准的大陆时区,结束了当地上千个时代的混乱.
de: In the "day of two noons", American and Canadian railroad companies institute four standard continental time zones, ending the confusion of thousands of local times.

t: 法国军队攻克了塞克·泰伊城堡.
te: French forces capture the Sơn Tây citadel.
dz: 通金运动:法国军队攻克了塞克·泰伊城堡.
de: Tonkin Campaign: French forces capture the Sơn Tây citadel.

t: 加拿大皇家德拉贡斯和加拿大皇家兵团是加拿大陆军的第一个常备部队骑兵和步兵团被组建.
te: The Royal Canadian Dragoons and The Royal Canadian Regiment, the first Permanent Force cavalry and infantry regiments o…
dz: 加拿大皇家德拉贡斯和加拿大皇家兵团是加拿大陆军的第一个常备部队骑兵和步兵团被组建.
de: The Royal Canadian Dragoons and The Royal Canadian Regiment, the first Permanent Force cavalry and infantry regiments of the Canadian Army, are formed.
